answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped within normal variation due to a product break affecting Chrome users.
explanation: Overall conversion fell from {F1} to {F2} after Cyber Monday, staying within normal weekly variation.
The primary cause was an issue on Chrome, where add-to-cart rates after a product view dropped significantly.
This browser-specific disruption began around {F30} and drove the majority of the site-wide decline.
answer.next_step: Investigate recent frontend changes or JavaScript errors specific to the Chrome browser starting around December 11.
